normalization_rule: Each normalized panel carries a nonempty exact excerpt from the immutable source answer. Missing assertions remain unknown. Free-form answers may be manually normalized with recorded excerpts.
fully_qualified: Execution evidence valid, exact target set, all finite-pool-coverable targets have at least one valid current-session complete/readable ref, finite-pool-uncoverable reasons accurate, no false covered or unknown overclaim.
image_delivery_rule: Generated current-session PNG/array refs must be publicly retrievable. Actual CLI image delivery is counted separately and is not required for every referenced frame.
cost_gate: All six answers and costs retained. Complete paired time comparisons require all three quality-complete pairs. No optimal-view-count gate or partial-cost winner.
